notice: Unofficial. Not affiliated with any vendor. Prices are as published by each channel at observed_at, in the currency of the record (USD, or CNY for China sites; never converted); check the source before relying on them.

channels.name: OpenAI API
channels.notes: Standard tier. Regional data-residency endpoints carry a 10% uplift per the source page.

channels.name: Gemini Developer API
channels.notes: Paid tier.

channels.name: DeepSeek API
channels.notes: Peak rate shown as the list price; off-peak rate is a separate tier.

channels.name: Model Studio, China (Beijing)
channels.notes: Prices as published in USD on the international pricing page.

channels.name: Z.AI API
channels.notes: International platform. The China platform (bigmodel.cn, CNY) is a separate channel.

channels.name: MiniMax API
channels.notes: Standard service tier. Priority tier is 1.5x.

channels.name: Vertex AI, global endpoint
channels.notes: Global endpoint: served from any Google Cloud region, no residency guarantee.

channels.name: Vertex AI, regional endpoint (any pinned region)
channels.notes: Requests pinned to one chosen Google Cloud region (for example us-central1, europe-west4 or asia-northeast1). One price for every regional endpoint, published as "Non-global".

channels.name: Amazon Bedrock, US East (N. Virginia)
channels.notes: On-demand, standard tier.

channels.name: OpenRouter
channels.notes: Price listed by OpenRouter's public models API. The billed price can depend on the provider OpenRouter routes to.

channels.name: Azure AI Foundry, Global deployment
channels.notes: Standard tier, Global deployment: the same price in all 26 listed Azure regions.

channels.name: Azure AI Foundry, Data Zone (US)
channels.notes: Standard tier, Data Zone deployment in the 7 US regions (centralus, eastus, eastus2, northcentralus, southcentralus, westus, westus3).

channels.name: Azure AI Foundry, Data Zone (EU)
channels.notes: Standard tier, Data Zone deployment in the 6 EU regions (francecentral, germanywestcentral, polandcentral, spaincentral, swedencentral, westeurope).

channels.name: Kimi API
channels.notes: platform.kimi.ai (formerly platform.moonshot.ai). Prices exclude taxes. The page renders in the browser; the snapshot is the rendered DOM captured by headless Chromium.

channels.name: Amazon Bedrock, global cross-region
channels.notes: Global inference profile: requests may be served from any commercial region. Price read from the us-east-1 price list (global-* service tiers).

channels.name: DeepSeek API, CNY price list
channels.notes: The same API, as priced in CNY on the Chinese pricing page. Peak rate shown as the list price; off-peak rate is a separate tier.

channels.name: Alibaba Cloud Bailian, China site (Beijing)
channels.notes: aliyun.com price list for the 华北 2（北京）region, in CNY. The international page also publishes Beijing prices in USD (the separate "Model Studio, China (Beijing)" channel); the two lists are set separately and are not conversions of each other.

channels.name: Zhipu BigModel, China site
channels.notes: bigmodel.cn, the China platform, in CNY. The international platform (Z.AI, USD) is a separate channel.

channels.name: MiniMax API, China site
channels.notes: platform.minimax.cn, in CNY. Standard service tier. Priority tier is 1.5x.

channels.name: Kimi API, China site
channels.notes: platform.kimi.com (formerly platform.moonshot.cn), in CNY. The page renders in the browser; the snapshot is the rendered DOM captured by headless Chromium.

coverage_gaps.note: Meta has no first-party paid API; Llama is listed through cloud and aggregator channels only.
Anthropic models on Amazon Bedrock are sold through AWS Marketplace and are not in the Bedrock price list API; not captured yet.
Bedrock price lists for Tokyo, Spain and Frankfurt do not list Llama 4 Maverick; only us-east-1 is shown.
The Cloud Billing Catalog lists Flex, Priority and Off-Peak SKUs for Gemini; only Standard and Batch are recorded so far.
OpenAI's pricing page has a Long context view for prompts over 272K input tokens; only the Short view is recorded so far. Cost estimates above the threshold are reported as not computable.

Thinking / reasoning token billing is recorded only where a channel's pricing page states it (Gemini API, Vertex AI, Alibaba qwen3.8-max, OpenRouter Gemini listings). For every other channel it is unknown, not assumed.

CNY price lists are recorded for DeepSeek, Alibaba Bailian (Beijing), Zhipu BigModel, MiniMax and Kimi. Billing rules (off-peak hours, long-input tiers, thinking tokens) are not yet recorded for these channels, so cost estimates on them return ranges.
